sqlx-macros-core 0.9.0

Macro support core for SQLx, the Rust SQL toolkit. Not intended to be used directly.

  • crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/sqlx-macros-core/0.9.0
  • Repository: https://github.com/launchbadge/sqlx
  • Documentation: https://docs.rs/sqlx-macros-core/0.9.0
  • License: MIT OR Apache-2.0

The package as published on crates.io carries no README. incan.pub wrote this one when it adopted the package as the Loaf crates-io/sqlx-macros-core.
